support_boundary: old-mode, shim, fallback, compatibility, unsupported, known-open, and alternate acceptance path conformance rows are non-positive unless a canonical behavior owner claims positive support

owned_manifest_groups.disposition: old-mode and parser fallback surfaces are parser rejections
shim, adapter, and unsupported feature claims are semantic rejections
runtime dispatch fallback claims are strict lowering/link errors
tracking-only gap evidence; not behavior support
historical planning shards retained for traceability only

retired_surface_rule: retired surfaces stay canonical rejection, strict-error, absent-support, known-open, or tracking-only evidence
